From plant room to dashboard

A well-designed BMS brings the building’s systems together, providing clear visibility of plant status, temperatures, alarms, schedules and energy performance.

From field devices and controllers through to the user interface, systems are configured with reliability, maintainability and future optimisation in mind.

About

Weeks Building Solutions specialises in BMS and HVAC controls, providing service, fault finding, commissioning and control system support across commercial buildings.

With hands-on experience working with BMS systems including Trend and Niagara, projects range from reactive service and fault finding to controller modifications, commissioning and optimisation.
